title: Vibrilify MAX — "clearing things up" (segment)
notes: Sophie, 2026-08-28: 'new segment - max voice / clearing things up / a tangled pile satisfyingly unfurls into its separate components / then a shimmering rainbow shooting star / sound effect / show title'. Two SFX she supplied (clearing_things_up.wav under the unfurl, Fairytale magic sparkle on the star). MoA register — her own note on the triple-action sequence: 'animated in the normal pill commercial style, molecules are like big blobby things'. The end card is REUSED from the v2 shoot (shot 11) so the segment ends on the identical title the spot ends on — free, and a re-render would drift the type. The unfurled frame is an EDIT against the tangle, not a fresh generation: the first pass came back a macro close-up of six rods at a different camera distance, so the morph would have read as a cut to another scene rather than the pile coming apart.

line.instructions: A national pharmaceutical TV commercial announcer, radiant and uplifting — the good-news turn of the ad. Warm, bright, full of gentle wonder. Unhurried.

moaStyle: Frame from the 3D mechanism-of-action animation inside a TV pharmaceutical commercial: glossy soft-body render, smooth blobby translucent shapes with subsurface glow, clean pale background, soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field.

shots.imagePrompt: A single dense snarled knot of thick glossy translucent lavender cords hovering in the center of the frame, hopelessly tangled around itself, every strand crossing every other strand. Clean pale off-white background with soft depth haze.

The SAME cords a moment later, completely untangled: the thick glossy translucent lavender cords have pulled free of one another and now hang across the middle of the frame as a row of separate, evenly spaced, gently curving strands, each one whole and distinct, calm and resolved. Clean pale off-white background with soft depth haze.
shots.matchLine: The attached photo is this SAME SHOT a moment EARLIER — the same tangled knot of cords, floating in the same place. Compose this frame to match its framing, object scale, camera distance, lighting and background EXACTLY.

shots.imagePrompt: A shimmering rainbow shooting star streaking across a flat solid lavender field, its trail a soft iridescent rainbow of glittering particles, the star's head a bright white shimmer. Clean, glossy, studio-lit commercial animation. No text.

clips.motionPrompt: The tangled knot of glossy lavender cords slowly and satisfyingly unfurls, each strand pulling free of the others and settling into its own neat separate line. Smooth soft 3D animation motion.
The shimmering rainbow shooting star streaks across the lavender field, its glittering rainbow trail sparkling and drifting behind it. Smooth glossy commercial animation.
clips.note: NO last_image on purpose. Morphing into the end card would have been the prettier transition, but the end card is TYPE — VIBRILIFY MAX and the horse fine print — and a wan morph target garbles lettering. The title arrives as the clean still instead, over the spot's own soft dissolve.

hold.note: Shortened from 3.2s: the sparkle's tail runs out around 11.3s and a longer card just adds silence.

sfx.note: her file, played QUIET as a bed. Front-loaded and decaying (hit at 0.20s, mean -37.4 dBFS), so one instance can only cover one moment — this one is texture under the announcer as the knot starts working.

her file again, at full lift, and THIS is the satisfying one: measured off the cut, the last strands pull free between 4.2s and 5.2s, so the 0.20s hit lands at 4.8s on the release — just clear of the VO's last word, and filling what was 1.5s of dead air. +19 was the first pass and put the transient at +4.4 dBFS, straight into the limiter.

her file. MEASURED peak -0.7 dBFS — the loudest of the three, and it plays with no VO over it, so it is trimmed rather than lifted. Its swell peaks 0.90s in, which puts the shimmer 0.6s into the star; the tail carries across the dissolve into the title.

sfxNote: Her two uploads, banked to Storage rather than committed (a public repo is the wrong home for licensed SFX). make-clearing.js reads them from VIB_SFX_DIR; the urls are here so any later run can re-fetch them.
mixNote: Levels are set from MEASURED peaks, not by ear: VO +4 (-8.4 → -4.4 dBFS) leads, the unfurl bed sits under it, the sparkle owns its own moment. alimiter at 0.94 is the backstop, not the mixer — if it is working hard the gains are wrong.
